notes.text: button, input text-like controls including size attributes, input button/reset/submit, checkbox, radio, range, color, hidden, file, image with explicit attributes, time, textarea including rows/cols attributes, select including size/multiple attributes, progress, and meter intrinsic sizes have parity coverage as independently positioned controls.
Common form controls are measured as replaced leaves so option children and anonymous control internals do not participate in the layout tree.
Native button text and textarea row/column metrics vary with the host Chromium platform; their parity checks use narrow, field-specific tolerances while other control dimensions remain exact.
Inline form-control formatting, fieldset and legend layout, option popup layout, placeholder text, and most control-specific UA styling are not modeled.
